scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1, turn 10, and turn 25, the customer expressed severe frustration over an erroneous direct debit after cancellation, but you failed to acknowledge his distress.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's billing issue at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At turn 11, you deflected responsibility by stating the erroneous direct debit was not your department's problem.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At turn 13, you made a condescending remark telling the customer he could hardly expect S-Net to mind his bank account for him.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: You failed to probe into the return details, dispatch dates, or equipment specifics before reviewing depot logs.

grader.scenario: Direct debit billed three months after cancelling contract and returning equipment
grader.notes: Gary handles the verification and eventually processes a card refund for an erroneously charged equipment fee, but displays severe soft skill faults. He fails to acknowledge Declan's frustration, deflects blame to central finance ('not our department's problem'), makes a condescending comment about minding bank accounts, and offers no paraphrasing.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:10] Customer: 'I am absolutely furious. I cancelled my S-Net broadband back in July...' followed by Agent immediately jumping to security checks without acknowledgment.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in his own words; only echoed tracking number at turn 19.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:35] Agent: 'That's entirely handled by automated banking clearing, so it's not our department's problem if the direct debit mandate was left open.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [01:52] Agent: 'If you don't keep track of your own bank mandates, you can hardly expect us to mind your bank account for you.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent did not probe customer regarding receipt, equipment type, or return carton specifics.
